professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate her developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and communication domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strength, such as emerging developmental skills, social engagement, and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention, including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. These challenges impact her functional performance in daily activities, necessitating focused support. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech therapy, and behavioral interventions will be beneficial to address Sabrina's comprehensive developmental needs. Based on the assessment findings, Sabrina is likely to benefit from a tailored intervention program designed to foster her strengths while addressing identified areas of need. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be essential to track her progress and adjust intervention strategies, ensuring her continued developmental success and promoting functional independence. Engaging Sabrina's family through education and involvement in therapeutic activities will be crucial in enhancing therapy outcomes and maintaining consistency across different environments.
